page.headline: Many drives. One clear space.
page.audience: For people managing files across more than one personal Google Drive account.

benefits.title: See the space you already have
benefits.body: View combined available storage and free space in each connected account, without checking every Drive separately.

benefits.title: Take the guesswork out of uploads
benefits.body: Drivepool chooses the connected account with the most free space that can fit the whole file.

benefits.title: Keep your uploads together
benefits.body: Browse and download the files you uploaded through Drivepool from one workspace.

useCases.title: Multiple personal accounts
useCases.body: Get a clearer picture of available storage across your connected Google accounts.

useCases.title: Everyday file uploads
useCases.body: Let the app select an account with enough space, then see where the upload was placed.

steps.title: Connect your first Drive
steps.body: Sign in with Google to open your workspace.

steps.title: Add your other accounts
steps.body: Connect additional personal Google Drive accounts and review available space.

steps.title: Upload and find your files
steps.body: Upload a file, check which account received it, and download it from your workspace.

faqs.title: Does Drivepool create extra storage?
faqs.body: No. It shows the available space in your connected accounts; it does not increase their storage limits.

faqs.title: Can a single file span multiple Drives?
faqs.body: No. Each file stays together in one account and must fit in that account’s available space.

faqs.title: Does it show every existing file in my Drives?
faqs.body: Drivepool lists files uploaded through the app. It is not a complete view of every pre-existing file in all accounts.
